one_knob_pin.note: theta_c=hbar_c pins the MIPT control parameter at p=1/2

verdict: GENUINE TRANSITION, pinned by the I3 crossing. (1) S(N/2): near-maximal VOLUME law at p->0 (slope dS/dN=0.50~1/2) collapsing to an N-INDEPENDENT AREA law (slope=0.01). (2) The tripartite mutual information I3 is large and NEGATIVE and grows with N at small p (volume; I3~-5.5), vanishes at large p (area; I3~-0.00), and the I3-vs-N curves CROSS at the scale-invariant point p_c~0.16 (literature p_c~0.16 for this class). A crossing of the scale-invariant order parameter is the decisive signature of a genuine phase transition -- a non-analyticity the one-knob lock's single-history visibility argument (analytic) provably cannot produce. The one-knob lock (theta_c=hbar_c) PINS the control parameter at p=1/2, deep in the AREA-law (classical) phase (p_c~0.16): the framework as written is frozen on the classical side. DECOUPLING theta_c -- the second variable -- opens the tuning axis and the transition; the order parameter is entanglement (the gravity/holography currency), and the classicality ratio hbar_c/theta_c becomes the axis of a genuine phase, not a smooth crossover. CONDITIONAL on COST=MONITORING (self-description keeps a record); recordless dephasing softens it to a crossover.
honesty: Underlying MIPT + I3 crossing are established (Li-Chen-Fisher 2018; Skinner-Ruhman-Nahum 2019; Zabalo et al. 2020). CWF content: mapping the two action sectors to scrambling vs self-description; the one-knob lock pins the control parameter (p=1/2, area-law) so the framework cannot access the transition; COST=MONITORING is the load-bearing assumption. Order parameter = entanglement = the gravity/holography currency; hbar_c/theta_c is the classicality axis.
